newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt wants to lease five public-sector companies.
newsitem.headline: Egypt wants to lease five public-sector companies.

text.p: The Egyptian state wants big foreign chemical companies to manage or lease five public-sector companies, the government newspaper al-Ahram said on Tuesday, quoting Public Enterprise Minister Atef Obeid.

It named four of the five companies as National Plastics, Graphite and Stationery, Canaltex Floorings and Modern Tanneries/Egyptian Leather Industries. All are subsidiaries of Chemical Industries Company, a state holding company.
The plan is part of the government's accelerated privatisation programme, but the newspaper gave no other details.
